name: Fused switch
summary: A fused switch combines a switching function with fuse protection.
description: A fused switch combines a switching function with fuse protection. The schematic should retain both functions so the fuse rating is not confused with the switch's operational rating.
readingNotes: Check whether the selected assembly moves the fuse carrier as part of its operation.

distinction: A switch with separate series fuses and a fuse-switch can have different mechanical constructions.
